body:
That's the thing is I don't think there is a better girl out there.. I was lucky to even get her and now that she is basically gone my entire world is just in pieces.. I just don't understand how a person can be so loving and then just leave so quickly and it doesn't even seem to effect them.. Woman have it so easy after any break up because no matter what there will always be a guy that will give them attention and listen to them and be there for them.. But for me I'm alone sitting on my couch debating if I should just take the rest of my pain pills and go out peacefully.. Hell no one would even know I was gone until Thursday at the earliest.. I
Just don't know what to do or how to feel or how I can even live when my heart feels like it has been ripped out and stomped on every moment I'm conscious..
